Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase. The players are out in the middle. Travis Head will take the opening spot along with David Warner. David Willey to bowl first. Let's play...
...THE CHASE...

Australia were consistent with their bowling as well. They chipped in with wickets at regular intervals but it was just due to one big innings, that they are chasing such a huge total. The skipper himself and Adam Zampa ended with three wickets. Australia were a bit off in the field, however, the way the pitch was behaving in the final phase. It feels, one big innings from the Aussie will help them chase this score down. Stay tuned for the chase.

England have just one man to thank at this stage and that is Malan. A superb recovery from England as at one stage even 250 will be impossible. England were four down in no time and needed a big partnership. Jos Buttler played a good hand but not for long. Dawid Malan was the mainstay. The others played around him. It was a one-man show in the end as Malan paced his innings really well. Got to his fifty while there were wickets falling at the other end but once things got back on track, he played some lusty blows and reached to his hundred. David Willey played a good innings at the back end and England will be happy with this score at the break.
Two runs to end the over! Full and on leg. Willey flicks it to deep mid-wicket. A poor throw helps Willey to get back for the second. ENGLAND END WITH 287.
Full and outside off. Willey fails to get past cover.
FOUR! Much needed! That was smacked! A full toss and Willey thumps it. almost takes Stones with him but his partner did well to duck. The ball races to the long off fence.
A yorker now, on leg. Willey backs away and jams it out for no run.
Stays away from the arc and serves it way outside off. Willey makes room but pushes it straight to point.
Quicker on the pads. Willey looks for the big heave but misses.
Ashton Agar to bowl the final over.
A full toss on middle and it tails in late and hits Stone on the pads as he looks to flick. An appeal but that was going down.
OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Pat Cummins gets his wicket. His third one. Cummins bangs in short and around middle. Wood looks to pull but gets a faint edge and Alex Carey doesn't make any mistake.
Commentary.Howout: c Alex Carey b Pat Cummins

Commentary.Commentary: Short in length and on middle. Willey looks to pull but gets a top edge and it goes behind square leg. Travis Head didn't settle under it well and ends up spilling it down. Dropped! A single from it.
Wide! A length ball, outside off. Willey looks to cut but misses.
A full toss on middle. Wood bunts it to deep square leg for a single.
Short again, outside off. Willey knocks it to mid off for a single.
Short in length and outside off. Wood pulls it to deep mid-wicket for one.
Down the leg side, this is hit to deep square leg for one.
Very full and on middle, eased to long on for one.
Smart stuff! Hit to the longer side and take two! On middle, nudged to mid-wicket for a couple.
Full and outside off. Wood drives it through point for a single.
Flatter and on middle. Willey clips it to mid-wicket, this time only for one.
Tossed up on middle. Willey flicks it to mid-wicket for easy two.
Full and on off. Willey pushes it to cover for one more.
A single as this is hit to mid on.
On middle, driven to mid on. Wood slips as he runs across and denies the single in the end.
FOUR! Through the gap! The English players play the cover drives so well. Pitched up, outside off. Wood drives it past cover. Green from mid off gives a chase but in vain.
Starc pushes this one outside off. Wood looks to cut but misses.
Very full and on middle. Willey looks to jam it out but gets an inside edge to fine leg for one. Reverse-swing again for Starc.
A single to end the over as this is driven to long off.
Tossed up on middle. David Willey pushes it back to Zampa.
On middle, kept out.
On middle, flicked to mid-wicket for one.

OUT! TAKEN! A bit easy this time for Agar! End of one of the best innings from Malan! He alone has helped his team reach to such a total! Needed to continue but has done enough, you say!  Zampa goes flat and on middle. Malan had to generate all the power as he rocks back and tries to launch over mid on but fails and Ashton Agar takes an easy catch. A bit of tiredness in that shot but nonetheless, end of a great innings from Malan.
Commentary.Howout: c Ashton Agar b Adam Zampa

Commentary.Commentary: On middle, swept to fine leg for a couple.

That was brilliant from Agar! Superman stuff! Short and outside off. Malan pulls it to deep mid-wicket. Agar leaps and gets his left hand to it. He knew he was going over the ropes so flicked the ball back in the ground, all in the air and saves five crucial runs for his team. Excellent stuff by him. He has been just superb on the field.
Wide! Too short and Malan leaves it alone. Wided.
Length ball, outside off. Willey pulls it past mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Beats the fielder! A length ball, outside off. Willey drives it hard and through covers for four more.
Length ball, outside off. Malan hits it to the right of mid off. Didn't come from the meat of the bat. Still a single.
Cummins stick to the same line and length, short and outside off. Malan misses his cut. Given as a wide. A harsh call from the umpire.
Short ball, outside off. Malan looks to cut but misses.
On middle, flicked past mid-wicket for one.
SIX! 300 looks gettable the way Malan is playing! Slower, full and on off. Malan gets on one knee and smokes it over mid-wicket for a biggie.
FOUR! One more boundary for Malan! This is in the arc for Malan, outside off, it's cut past point for a boundary.
Full and on off. Willey drives it through covers for one.
Short and outside off. Willey looks to cut but misses.
A low full toss on off. Malan goes across and heaves it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Flatter and outside off. Malan looks to reverse sweep but misses.
Dropped! A big chance! On a length and on middle. Willey punches it straight back to Starc who didn't see that coming. It was hit at a good pace and around Starc's knee who fails to catch it back.
Very full and outside off. Malan drives it to deep point for a single.
Starc misses his yorker and serves a full toss, sliding down. Malan misses his flick.
Crunched for one! Outside off, driven through covers for one.
Full ball on off. Willey nudges it to mid-wicket.
Full ball, outside off. Malan drives it to sweeper cover for a single.
Slower ball, outside off. Willey looks to push but misses. Good comeback from Agar after going for 10 in first two.
Tossed up on middle. Willey plays it back to Agar.
Full and outside off. Blocked out.
Short and outside off, cut to deep point for a single.
SIX! Malan targeting this over clearly! Floated, full and on middle. Malan launches it high over long on for a biggie.
FOUR! Well played! Very full and on the pads. Malan slog-sweeps it over mid-wicket for a one-bounce into the fence.
Leg bye! A yorker, Starc gets it to reverse-swing. Malan looks to flick but misses and it goes off the pads and to square leg for a single.
Starc with his go-to delivery, a yorker on middle, it swung late in. Willey gets his bat on it and it rolls to square leg for one. Australia appeal but it was off the bat.
A slower bumper on middle. Malan pulls it behind square leg for one.
Fuller ball, outside off. Malan drives on the up, more off the toe end of the bat and it lands safely in the deep cover region. Two runs.
Very full and this is driven to covers.
Wide! A loosener as this is spilled down the leg side. Malan misses his flick. Wided.
This is full and on off. Malan drives it back to Starc.
Flatter, slower and on middle, this one lands and spins in. Malan looks to drive but gets an inside edge past the pole and to fine leg for three runs. Fortune one.
Tossed up on middle. Willey nudges it to mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! This is full and outside off. Willey drives it through covers, in the gap for four runs.
On middle, kept out.

HUNDRED FOR MALAN! Excellent innings against a quality side. A one-man show till now and needs to continue. He has done incredibly well till now. Flatter and on off. Malan works it to long on for a single. A good start to the series for him.
Outside off. Malan misses his cut.
Quicker, flat and on middle. Willey rocks back to defend.
Full and on middle. Defended back to Zampa.
Tossed up on off. Malan bunts it to mid-wicket for one.
Flatter, slower and outside off. Willey punches it through covers for one.
On middle. Malan helps it to fine leg for quick single.
Wide! This is angled way outside off. Malan misses his drive. A wide given.
Slower through the air, outside off. Malan looks to push but misses.
Full and outside off. Willey works it to point.
Touch slow, flat and outside off. Willey looks to defend with a straight bat but gets an outside edge to third man for a brace.
Tossed up, way outside off. Willey tries to smash but misses.
Flatter and outside off. Willey knocks it to point.
Outside off, Malan pushes it through covers for a single. He is on 97 now.
Full and outside off, driven to cover.
Slower ball, outside off. Willey keeps it out.
David Willey walks in.

OUT! LBW! This time Zampa gets his man but Jordan challenges the decision! Zampa goes very quick, short and on middle. Jordan clears his front leg to pull but misses and gets hit high on the pads. An appeal for LBW and up goes the finger. Jordan reviews. No bat involved shows the technology. THREE REDS on the Ball Tracking and Zampa gets his second wicket. Speed was key for Zampa here.

A googly on the slower side, flatter and on middle. Jordan prods to defend but gets hit on the pads. An appeal for LBW but the umpire doesn't move as the replay later shows there was a big inside edge. A review burned by Australia.
Full again, outside off. Malan pushes it through cover for one.
A googly, angling across and going more away from Malan who looks to drive but misses. Well bowled.
On middle, drilled to long on for one.
On middle. Malan plays with ease to fine leg for a couple.
Just short! Flighted, full and outside off. Jordan is early as he looks to drive, ends up slicing it over cover and just short of the man runnings from the deep. One.
Quicker, full and angling on middle. Jordan works it to short fine leg.
This is full and on off, pushed to cover.
On middle, eased to long on for a single.
Flatter and outside off. Malan knocks it to point.
Very full and on middle. Malan makes room and drives it through point for one.
FOUR! Two in a row. Malan is into the 90s! Tossed up on middle. Malan steps across and slog-sweeps it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
FOUR! Malan continues to find boundaries in each over! This is full and on the pads, too straight and Malan sweeps it to deep square leg for four.
A googly on the shorter side. Jordan flicks it to square leg for one.
This is full and angling on middle. Jordan sweeps it behind square on the leg side for one.
Tossed up on middle. Blocked out.
5 from it! Full and outside off. Malan opens the face of the bat in the last moment and plays it to short third man.
Full and outside off, Malan drives it straight to covers.
Targets the stumps now. Jordan taps it to point for one.
This is full and outside off. Malan drives it firmly through covers for one.
Agar goes full and outside off. Jordan looks to drive but gets an outside edge, past short third man for three runs.
This is full and on off, pushed back to the bowler.
FOUR! Malan is not letting the loose deliveries go away! Short in length and outside off. Malan slaps it on the up and over point for a boundary. What an innings he is playing here.
A single as this is hit to mid-wicket.
Slanting on middle. Malan nudges it to square leg for a single.
A full toss, outside off. Malan finds the gap through covers and gets two runs.
Three runs! This is on a length and outside off. Jordan pushes it past mid off for three runs.
Leg bye! A length ball on the pads. Malan misses his flick and it goes off the pads to square leg for a leg bye. An appeal for LBW but was pitching outside leg.
Outside off. Malan steps across and tucks it through mid-wicket for one.
Flatter, quicker and outside off. Malan punches it to cover.
Very full and on middle. Jordan swings his bat, gets an inside edge and it goes to fine leg for one.
Tossed up on middle. Jordan sweeps it to short fine leg.
On middle, kept out.
Outside off, driven to cover.
This is full and outside off. Malan mistimes his hit to mid off.
Full again and Malan bags two as he drives it through covers.
This is full and outside off. Malan drives it through covers for a brace.
Short and on middle. Malan fends it on the leg side.
Chris Jordan comes in.

OUT! RUN OUT! BULLSEYE FROM AGAR! What a hit from him and right after the drinks break, Australia find the breakthrough. Length and outside off. Dawson knocks it straight to point. He runs across but was not fully committed to his running. Ashton Agar at point had ample time to aim at his target and he scores. A direct-hit and Dawson was not even in the frame.
Length and on top of off. Defended out.
Wide! Too short and around off. Dawson looks to pull but misses. A wide given.

Drinks! Since the wicket of Buttler, England have done well to score at a quick rate. The stand between these two is blossoming but need to continue. Australia know if they get Malan, they will be on the front foot but Dawid Malan is looking superb and in no mind to give away his wicket any time soon.
Full and on off, pushed through point for a single.

Almost had him! Tossed up on middle, angling in. Malan tries to play the reverse sweep but gets an inside edge and the ball goes past the off pole and to third man for a single. Agar anticipated what was coming.
Flatter and on off. Malan nudges it to mid-wicket.
Outside off, kept out.
FOUR! Good shot! Short and way outside off. Malan cuts it through point for a boundary.
Played all over! This is full and outside off. Malan initially tries to scoop behind the keeper but ends up hitting back to the bowler of the toe end of the bat.
Ashton Agar to bowl now.
This is full and on off. Malan steps across and tucks it to mid on for one.
Short again, outside off. Dawson pulls it behind square leg for one. 150 up.
Short and on middle. Defended out.
Outside off, fuller side, drilled through covers for one.
Full and on off. Dawson eases it to mid off. Cummins hits the stumps at the bowler's end but Dawson was in comfortably.
Green starts with a bouncer on middle. Dawson sits down.
Cameron Green is back on.
Way outside off. Dawson dabs it to short third man where Starc does well to dive to his left and stop it. A single to end the over.
Very full now, outside off. Malan strokes it to deep cover for one.
Full and outside off, driven to point.
Zampa serves it slow and around middle. Malan checks his shot as he pushes on the up to mid off.
Shorter and outside off. Dawson plays it to deep point for one.
Tossed up on middle. Dawson defends on the front foot.
Slanting on the pads. Dawson flicks it to square leg for one. 12 runs off the over.
Length and outside off. Blocked out.
Goes short now on middle, this is pulled to deep square leg for one.

SIX! Malan changing gears now! Cummins again goes full, around middle. Malan gets across and slog-sweeps it behind square on the leg side for a boundary. It was a slower ball as well but Malan picked it up really well.
FOUR! Beautiful shot! Cummins pitches it up, outside off. Malan drives it crisply through covers and it races into the fence.
Short of a length and outside off at 132.2 clicks. Malan looks to punch but misses.
Slides one on the pads. Dawson pushes it to mid-wicket.
Too full from Zampa, around off. Malan drives it past the cover fielder for a single.
Flatter and outside off. Dawson knocks it through covers for one more.
FIFTY FOR MALAN! A good innings from him. Much needed one and need to play a big one here! Fuller and outside off, Malan drives it to deep cover for a single.
Full and on middle, it is pushed back to the bowler.
Tossed up on middle, spins in. Dawson sweeps it to fine leg for three runs. It came off the bat, Zampa's appeal was denied straightaway.
Excellent fielding! Fuller and on off, Malan strokes it firmly to the right of Smith. He gets down quickly and stops it.
Good length and on off, defended.
SIX! Over the fence! That has come out of nowhere! He moves one short of a half ton! This is fuller and on off, Malan heaves it over the mid-wicket fence for a biggie.
Outside off, Malan slashes but misses.
On off, blocked.
Good length and on off, Malan pushes it to covers.
Outside off, this is pushed through covers for one.
On middle, this is pushed back to the bowler.
Chance! A really tough one. Would have been a sharp, sharp catch! Shorter and outside off, Malan looks to push at it, it goes off a thick outside edge and hits the outer part of the glove of Carey.
Tossed up on off, Dawson works it down to long on and gets to the other end.
On middle, defended.

OUT! TAKEN! The stand reaches fifty and Buttler falls. Zampa strikes and that is the wicket Australia wanted. Zampa is elated. He tosses it up on off, Buttler looks to go over cover but there is not a lot of room on offer. He ends up chipping it a lot straighter than he would have liked. The man at mid off, Agar, moves to his left and takes a decent catch. Half the side back in the hut now for England. Buttler walks back after getting off to a start. They needed him to go on.
Commentary.Howout: c Ashton Agar b Adam Zampa

Commentary.Commentary: On middle, this is pushed towards mid on for a quick run.
Buttler shuffles across again. Cummins goes fuller and outside off, left alone.

Nicely played! Buttler moves across and then works this from off through mid-wicket for two. Fifty-run stand up and it is an important one. They are slowly taking England out of trouble. The two need to go on.
Fuller and outside off, this is hit through covers for one.
WIDE! Slips this one down the leg side. Malan looks to flick but misses.
Fuller and on middle, this is worked to the right of mid on for one.
Outside off, Malan guides it down to third man and takes one.
Fuller and around off, Buttler plays it through cover and takes two.
Slightly shorter and on off, Buttler plays it late but to point.
On the stumps, this is nudged around the corner for one.
Angled into the pads, this is worked through square leg for one.
On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
Fuller and on off, this is pushed down to long off for one.
Bangs it short and on the body, this is worked towards the leg side for one.
On middle, this is pushed back to the bowler.
WIDE! Shorter but down the leg side. Buttler looks to pull but misses. Wided.
Good length and on off, this is pushed to cover,.
BEATEN! That is a lovely delivery! Length and on off, this lands and moves away. Buttler is beaten as he tries to defend.
Fuller and on middle, this is pushed to mid off for one.
On middle, Buttler works it through mid-wicket for one.
On the shorter side, this is pushed to cover.
On off, this is pushed to cover.
Fuller and on middle, Buttler pushes it down to long off for a single.
Outside off, on the fuller side again, Malan hits it through covers and takes one.
On middle, Malan hits it wide of long on and takes two.
Fuller to begin with, on off, this is pushed to cover.
A good length delivery to end, on off, Buttler plays it to mid off.
Bangs it short, a slower short ball. Buttler is early in the pull. He is beaten.
Really good fielding again! On the pads, this is worked down to fine leg. Head runs to his right, slides and saves two for his side.
On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.

That would have been a stunner! Ashton Agar almost did something spectacular. In the end, he did save a boundary for his side. Outside off, this is samshed towards point. Agar dives to his left, sticks a hand out but the ball does not stay in. Brilliant effort.
Another one on a length and around off, Malan defends it onto the ground.
Good length and around off, Malan guides it towards point and gets to the other end.
A slower ball, fuller and on off, this is hit down to long on for one.

That must have stung! One can call that an opportunity but it needed to stick! Length and on off, Buttler thumps it back to the left of Stoinis! He sticks his left hand out, it hits the hand and goes to mid off. Marcus Stoinis is in a little pain.
Angled into the pads, this is worked down to fine leg for one.
Stoinis gets away with one! Just the single from the freebie! Short and on the body, Buttler looks to hit it way too hard, it goes more off the toe-end towards fine leg for one.
Length again and on off, Malan strokes it through covers for one. NO BALL! Marcus Stoinis has overstepped. Free Hit coming up and it is Buttler on strike.
Good length and on off, kept out.
A single to end! Fuller and outside off, this is carved through point for one.
WIDE! Short and well wide outside off, Malan goes after it but misses. Wided.
Outside off, left alone.
Good length and on off, defended.
Goes short again, this time Buttler pulls it through square leg and takes one.
Slightly shorter and on middle, kept out.
On middle, this is worked to mid on.
Off the outside edge but one! Outside off, Buttler throws his bat at it, it goes off the outside edge down to third man for one.
Angled into the pads, this is worked towards mid-wicket. The fielder dives to his left and stops it.
On off, defended.

FOUR! That is pure timing! Just glorious! He is hitting the ball so well. Shorter and on off, Buttler stands tall and pushes it past cover. The fielder in the deep runs to his right, dives but fails to stop it.
Angled into the pads, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
On middle, this is worked to mid-wicket.
Angled into the pads, Malan plays it through square leg and gets to the other end.
On off, defended.
Good length and on off, this is guided to point.
FOUR! Shorter side and it races away! Very nicely hit! Shorter and on the body, this is pulled past square leg for another boundary.
Outside off, this is guided down to third man for one.
Good length and on off, this is pushed to mid on.
Now follows the boundary with a single as this is worked down to fine leg. Positive from Buttler to begin with. 11 from Marcus Stoinis' first but an important wicket.
FOUR! Lovely stroke! Just his third ball and that shot shows the confidence he is in! On middle, fuller, Buttler lofts it over mid on for a boundary.
Buttler walks across again, this is on a length and around off, Buttler looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads.
Buttler is off the mark! On off, he steps forward and across and works it through mid-wicket for two.

DRINKS! Australia are well and truly on top at the moment! They have England's top order back in the hut and they will want to continue the good work. England on the other hand, need a partnership. Malan has begun well and they will hope Jos Buttler can do well too. The two do have the caliber but can they do it?

OUT! TIMBER! A boundary to begin his spell and now he strikes back! Marcus Stoinis is absolutely delighted as he breaks the stand which was going along nicely for England. That is another top nut. This lands outside off, it is on a length. It pitches and then jags back in. Sam Billings looks to play an expansive drive down the ground but this sneaks between the gap of bat and pad and hits the stumps. Marcus Stoinis is pumped up. Australia remain on top.
FOUR! That is a wonderful stroke! Welcome into the attack, Marcus Stoinis! This is full and on off, Sam Billings strokes it down the ground to the long off fence.
Top edge but no one there! Shorter and on middle, Sam Billings looks to pull, it goes off the splice, lands safe in the square leg region. One taken.
On off, defended.
Fuller and on off, this is pushed through covers for one.
BEATEN! Length and outside off, this lands outside off and moves away. Malan looks to guide it down to third man but is beaten.
Goes short now and on middle, Malan looks to pull, it goes off the splice through mid-wicket for two.
On middle, Sam Billings pushes it towards mid on and gets to the other end.
A single to end! An expensive start from Agar! On off, this is pushed through covers for one.
Outside off, this is pushed down to long off for one more.
On middle, this is worked to mid-wicket.
FOUR! That is trademark Malan! Goes down on one knee and then plays the slog sweep, he hits it wide of the fielder at deep mid-wicket for a boundary.
On off, this is pushed through covers for one.
On middle, this is worked down to long on for one.
Back of a length and on off, this is guided to point. Tidy from Green.
Another leave as this too is bowled outside off.
On middle, defended.
Fuller and on off, Sam Billings strokes it through covers for two.
Another one just outside off, not played at.
Outside off, not played at.
FOUR! Timed wonderfully! A boundary to begin this over and now one to end it! Length and on off, this is hit through covers for a boundary.

A loud appeal but turned down! No review taken too! Looked close but Hawk Eye shows it to be pitching outside leg. Malan walks right across. This lands around leg. Malan looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads. A loud shout but turned down.
Angled into the pads, Sam Billings works it around the corner and takes one.
Lovely bowling! Length again and on off, this lands and moves away. Billings looks to defend but is beaten.
On middle, Billings gets right behind the line and keeps it out.
FOUR! On the up! Lovely shot! On middle, Billings strokes it down the ground and this races away to the long on fence. Good start to the over and that should give Billings some confidence.
A good comeback then from Green after that first ball! On a length and around middle, kept out.
That is brilliant fielding! Shorter and on middle, this is pulled towards square leg. The fielder dives to his left and stops it brilliant. Saves at least two for his side.
Another one on a length and around off, kept out.
A lot of movement of the wicket there! Length and around off, this lands and moves away a long way. Malan is beaten as he tries to defend.
Good length and on off, kept out.
That is a really good delivery! Bends his back on this one, a real effort ball, it is short and on middle. Dawid Malan evades it. He is not happy with it not being called a wide.
NO BALL AND FOUR! Not the start Green and his side would have wanted from him! This is on a length and around off, Malan pushes it past cover and this one races away. Free Hit coming up too.
A harmless nut to end but an over with a wicket in it! Outside off again, not played at.
Outside off, left alone.
BEATEN! That ball could have been left! Length and outside off, Billings pushes at it but is beaten.
Billings is off the mark! Angled into the pads, this is clipped through square leg for two.
Slightly shorter and outside off, Sam Billings evades it.

OUT! EDGED AND TAKEN! Number three goes down and England in all sorts now. Not a good comeback for Vince too on his return into the side and Cummins has his second. The skipper leading from the front. Lovely nut. On a length and around off, it angles in at first, lands and then moves away. Vince looks to play the original trajectory but the movement does him in. It goes off the outside edge and Carey does the rest.
Commentary.Howout: c Alex Carey b Pat Cummins

Commentary.Commentary: A little too high! Length and outside off, this lands and jags back in. Malan looks to flick but misses to get hit high on the pads. Half an appeal but turned down.
On the fuller side this time, on off, Malan looks to drive but it goes off the inner half back to the bowler.
FOUR! Clipped away nicely! It was uppish but in the gap! Bread and butter for Malan! On his pads, he clips it and this one races away to the mid-wicket fence.
Fuller this time and on middle, Malan plays it to mid on.
Three! Clipped away nicely! Angled into the pads, Vince plays it late and through square leg. Long chase for the fielder at square leg and he saves a run for his side.
On middle, some extra bounce, Malan plays it well by taking one hand off the handle and for a single as it goes down to fine leg.
Malan is off the mark! Slightly fuller and on off, this is pushed past the bowler, towards mid off for one.
That has been nailed but straight to the fielder! Length and on off, Malan hits it on the up but to Stoinis at covers.
Outside off and on a length again, Malan shoulders arms to this one.
Good length and on off, Malan pushes it towards cover.
Width on offer this time as it is wider outside off, the length is the same as the last ball. Malan though is happy to leave it alone.
Good length and on off, relentless stuff from Cummins. This is pushed to mid off.
Vince is off the mark! Just a push for two! Slightly fuller and around off, Vince leans into it and strokes it through covers. Easy two. End of another successful over for the Aussies.
Still the one that goes away, it is on a length and around off, Vince guides it to point.

Angles this one away again from just around the 5th stump channel. Left alone. Two balls, both angled away, probably it is time for the one that comes in, also one which has troubled Vince a lot in his career.
That is a loose stroke to begin with! Shorter and outside off, angling away. Vince throws his bat at one he should be leaving. Luckily for him, he gets beaten.

OUT! TIMBER! That is an absolute beauty from Starc! Roy's comeback into the side is not a good one and England in trouble as they have lost both the openers within the first 5 overs. The late swing does him in. This is a length ball, it lands around off and cuts back in sharply. Roy plays all around it. Not sure what kind of shot he was looking to play, probably just trying to cover the movement and get bat on ball but fails to do so and the stumps are hit.

That shot should really make Roy feel good! Length and on off, Roy leans into it and strokes it past mid off. Cummins hares after it and pushes it back in. Good effort from the Aussie skipper after bowling the over prior to this one. He keeps it down to two.

OUT! EDGED AND TAKEN! Cummins has his revenge and he draws first blood for his side. Gets rid of the dangerous Salt! This is on a length and around off, it lands and then moves away. Salt looks to defend but this flies off the outside edge and straight into the hands of Steven Smith! He makes no mistake and that is the perfect start for the home side.
Commentary.Howout: c Steven Smith b Pat Cummins

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! SHOT! That has been hit with disdain! Salt just moves acorss towards the off side. This is a length delivery around off, he nonchalantly just flicks it over the square leg fielder and it goes into the fence. Second boundary in the over.
Slashes but misses! Extra bounce. Shorter and outside off, Salt goes after it but no connection.
Good comeback from Cummins! He drags his length back a touch and gets it to move away after landing it on off. Salt is beaten as he tries to defend.

FOUR! That is creamed! Lovely stroke from Salt! Fuller and on off, a half volley, probably looking for some swing, there is none and it comes onto the bat nicely. Salt strokes it down the ground past mid off and into the fence. Salt has begun well.
Back of a length, angling into the body, Roy nudges it towards square leg and gets to the other end.
Beats the outside edge yet again! This is a length ball, it lands around off and then seams away. Salt is beaten as he looks to drive.
Two! Length and on off, Salt pushes it on the up through covers for two.
Bangs it short this time and on the body, Roy clips it down to fine leg and takes an easy single.
A little too high! On the pads, Roy looks to flick but misses and gets hit high on the pads.
OHHH! That came back in late! This starts outside off and it shapes in late. Roy probably was thinking of leaving it but then looks to defend, he gets an inside edge onto his body.
That is a poor shot! Especially early on in his innings! This is full and quite wide outside off. Roy goes after it away from the body but is beaten.

That is a peach to end the over! A really good start from the Aussie skipper. He goes wide of the crease, angles it into the off pole, it is a length ball, this lands and moves away, whizzes past the outside edge of Salt's bat as he tries to block.
Drags his length back this time and angles it into the pads, Salt looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads.
Nice looking drive but for no runs! On middle, slightly fuller, Salt plays it to mid on.
Another very good shot! This wicket seems a really good one so far. On middle, this is pushed to mid on.
That is a really good delivery! Back of a length and on off, this lands and moves away. Salt is beaten all ends up as he tries to defend.
Tip and run! Good length and on off, Roy pushes it towards cover and gets to the other end.
A dot to end! A good first over though for England. Fuller and on off, this is pushed to mid off.
Angles this one across, goes slightly fuller again and outside off, Salt goes after it but misses.

FOUR! Thumped down the ground! That is a lovely way to get off the mark! Starc goes full, he gets it to tail back in nicely from around off. Salt is quite aware about that and he does not plant his front foot across, shows the full face of the bat and strokes it down the ground for a boundary. First of the game.
Roy and England are underway! Angled into the pads, Roy clips it behind square on the leg side for one.
That is right off the middle but to the fielder! A stroke though which should make Roy feel good! Fuller and on middle, Roy pushes it to mid on.
A little bit of movement to begin with! It is outside off, shapes back in a little but not enough to either make the batter play or hit the off pole.

It is time for the action to begin! The Australian players make their way out to the middle and are followed by the English openers, Philip Salt and Jason Roy! Mitchell Starc has the first new ball in hand! Here we go...
ENGLAND (PLAYING XI) - Jason Roy, Philip Salt, Dawid Malan, James Vince, Sam Billings, Jos Buttler (WK/C), Liam Dawson, Chris Jordan, David Willey, Luke Wood, Olly Stone.
AUSTRALIA (PLAYING XI) - David Warner, Travis Head, Steven Smith, Marnus Labuschagne, Alex Carey (WK), Marcus Stoinis, Cameron Green, Ashton Agar, Pat Cummins(c), Mitchell Starc, Adam Zampa.
TOSS - Australia have won the toss and ELECTED TO FIELD!

The Aussies have named a full straight squad and with Finch retiring from this format, it is Cummins who will be leading the hosts. England on the other hand, will have a different look to their side than what we witnessed in the shortest format recently. The likes of Roy, Billings and Vince return to the squad and with the 50-over World Cup coming up, the players would love to make a statement. This promises to be a cracker. Stay tuned.

After an amazing T20 World Cup, cricketing action continues in Australia. The currently crowned World Champions, England will be taking on the side who were the T20I champions before this edition of the World Cup, Australia. The format though is a different one and it is the 50-over one. For those who do not remember, the English are the World Cup holders in this format too. The Aussies though will be hungry to do well in this series especially after enduring a poor World Cup campaign.
